initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value:
The Yellow Dwarf Star at the center of the Asnary System. 
It is similar in size and age to the star in the historical Sol System.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Hot, Desert Planet with a nauseating, toxic atmosphere and highly acidic red seas. The planet does have wildlife, though much of it is hostile. The planet is sparsely inhabited by mining colonies that seek to extract the planet’s rich mineral resources.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Stormy, Deathly Toxic Moon where only extremophile lichens can survive. The Planet's Surface is made primarily of dark Iron-Rich Sediment and Rock.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Moon covered by Shallow Oceans and small islands. While quite hot, it's in a survivable temperature range for some species, and it is mainly used as a research outpost for the early life that has evolved there.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Humid, Swampy planet. Much of the planet’s flora is actually multiple organisms, working in symbiotic relationships, and all fauna seem to be descended from a single species of flat, fish-like organism that still dominates much of the shallow water ecosystems. The planet has a booming manufacturing industry.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Snowy Planet with a Tundra-esque biosphere, notable for the red colour of its plants. Much of the Fauna on the planet have been domesticated, but there are some large predators in the wild outside the outposts. The planet boasts mainly trading and military outposts.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Barren, Rocky Moon with No Atmosphere.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Gaseous, Stormy Planet with a Teal-Green Hue.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Gigantic Gas Planet with intense storms and a Coppery Hue. Due to strange magnetic fields, the planet contains floating “islands” of iron and copper. There have been attempts to extract the resources on this planet, but none have been successful due to the volatile conditions.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: Megastation III is the last of the old Megastations, gigantic space stations the size of Cities which orbited Gas Giants and functioned as major Urban Centres. Though old and in slight disrepair, Megastation III remains the largest population center in the Asnary 31-A System.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: This Moon was once home to a large mining colony run by Salvision Industries, but it is now abandoned for unknown reasons.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Rocky, Dusty Moon home to the Terran Confederacy's Largest Training Camp.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: The Red Dwarf Star at the center of the Rufira System. The Light it emits is slightly weaker than other stars.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Foggy Planet covered in Deep Ocean, notable for being rich in a resource required for the production of Drive Fuel. The Planet is dotted with gigantic megastructures built to extract this resource, similar to Oil Rigs.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Trading Station with a decent permanent population.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Tropical, Shallow Ocean Planet with Coral-Like Flora that dominates both Land and Sea. The Planet's Sapient Species, the Cerakans, have been waging a brutal world war for over 25 years, the reason for which is no longer known.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Frigid Mining Outpost Planet, rich in mineral resources. There is evidence of an old civilization on this planet, with Ancient Technology sometimes being unearthed from the ice.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Rocky, Cold Moon that manages to hold a stable population. It is primarily an Industrial Moon, housing Salvision's main Drive Fuel Manufacturing Plant.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: The Primary Home of The Terran Confederacy, Helios IV is an Earthlike Planet, being home to many continents and regions, and with a notable golden hue to its plant-life. It is home to the Largest Cities in the Rufira System.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Densely Forested Moon with a powerful electromagnetic field, which stops communications from reaching in or out of the moon's atmosphere. No Research Missions have returned.

initialVariables.name: Description
initialVariables.value: A Toxic Dwarf Planet, near-identical in Atmospheric and Mineral Makeup to the historic Sol System's 'Venus'.
